data.gender_notes: Aaima is used as a unisex name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From Arabic aʾimma (أئمة), the plural of imām 'leader, guide, exemplar', from the root ʾ-m-m. Used as a female given name in Muslim communities. Aaima therefore means “Leaders; guides; exemplars (plural of imam)”. Arabic plural aʾimma 'leaders, guides', from imām (root ʾ-m-m).
data.spiritual_meaning: Aaima expresses “Mother of Aisha”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From Arabic aʾimma (أئمة), the plural of imām 'leader, guide, exemplar', from the root ʾ-m-m. Used as a female given name in Muslim communities.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aaima total 16, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.

faq.q: What is the singular of Aaima?
faq.a: The singular of Aaima (أئمة) is imām, meaning 'leader, guide, exemplar'. Aaima is the plural, so it means 'leaders' or 'guides'.

faq.q: What does the name Aaima mean?
faq.a: Aaima means “Leaders; guides; exemplars (plural of imam)”.

faq.q: Where does the name Aaima come from?
What is the linguistic root of Aaima?
faq.a: The root of Aaima is أ-م-م (ʾ-m-m).

faq.q: How is Aaima written in Arabic script?
faq.a: Aaima is written أئمة in Arabic script.

faq.q: Is Aaima a boy's or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aaima is used as a female name.

faq.q: Does Aaima appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: No. Aaima is not a Qur'anic name; it is used in Muslim naming tradition.

faq.q: Is the meaning of Aaima verified?
faq.a: Yes — the meaning “Leaders; guides; exemplars (plural of imam)” is established by Arabic plural aʾimma 'leaders, guides', from imām (root ʾ-m-m)..
